body: Chief decision: InvocationId is not complete authority. Approved a corrected narrow seam: invariant OutputTargetIdentity[Id] derives canonical bytes/parts; library code domain-separates and hashes them. Built-in String uses exact UTF-8; no toString/generic JSON identity or caller-supplied per-value checksum. Bind both universe and TargetAccount IDs; contextual decode rederives; refuse unequal in-scope IDs whose derived identities collapse. Full courts and scope are in msg-01M1CNE378K625ES6ZMXVWED4N.
